WITH transaction_trader AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON ab.translink = t.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
), counts AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM transaction_trader
  GROUP BY tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       transaction_count AS average_count,
       share_of_total AS average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY tradekind;
